Amarakk is a haranir located in Harandar. A member of the Shul'ka, he was charged with defeating the abominations that inhabited the Rift of Aln, and amazed a working knowledge of the Rift's many dangers. When adventurers visited the region, he aided them in their journey through the region even as he trained En'liahn, a newer member of the order. Amarakk later thanked the adventurer after he rescued En'liahn, weakened by the innate madness of the Rift, from Morta'ka the Sundered Echo. After the Battle of the Bridge, he aided the assault on the Darkwell.
Amarakk's Influence is provided by Amarakk for Before They Grow.

Andari was a Lamplighter of the Hallowfall Arathi and the best friend of Faerin Lothar. They convinced the young Faerin, who'd lost her eye and arm during the expedition's arrival to Hallowfall, to play Light's Gambit to learn strategy, as a way to get her to rest from her constant military training. When Faerin and Andari lost game pieces, they started making new ones as a hobby. Andari's kindness and friendship helped Faerin mentally heal from her trauma. At some point, the traitor Aelric Leid ambushed Andari. Andari was killed in the Harrowing Depths when they were trying to hold off a small horde of monsters from reaching a tower Faerin was defending. Faerin deeply misses Andari, initial

Andromeda was the codename of a canceled Warcraft game. It was led by Alex Afrasiabi. Andromeda was a [https://godofwar.fandom.com/wiki/God_of_War_Wiki God of War]-styled game that would have featured Thrall as its protagonist. It was canceled when Afrasiabi was fired in 2020. The small team that had worked on Andromeda was disbanded, though were not told why. Blizzard looked for a new director for the project but couldn't find one; the project was cancelled, and its developers assigned to other projects.
